subject: Developer quickstart -> Technical demo: calendar availability and prep
messages:
From: Julie Park <julie@buildloop.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickstart — requesting a tech demo and environment details

Hi Camila,

I signed up through the developer quickstart this morning and poked around the docs. We're evaluating Redwood to replace our homegrown embedding service — developer intent is: low-latency gen + affordable embedding throughput.

Can we get a 30–45 min technical demo with someone from the runtime/ops side? I'd like to cover:
- expected latency at 2–3k reqs/min
- batching/kv-cache behavior for short-lived chat sessions
- deployment options (hosted vs dedicated) for EU/US traffic split

We're a small infra team (2 backend, 1 ML) — me + Alex (cc'd on our side at alex@buildloop.com). Prefer afternoons PST.

I attached a couple screenshots of our quickstart run and a short checklist of what we'd like to validate.

Thanks,
Julie
Product Manager — BuildLoop
julie@buildloop.com

Attachments: quickstart-screenshots.png (image), pre-demo-checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Julie Park <julie@buildloop.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickstart — scheduling a technical demo with runtime engineer

Hi Julie — great to meet you and thanks for signing up + sharing the checklist.

We can absolutely run a technical walkthrough that focuses on latency, batching, and deployment modes. I'm looping in Vivek (SDR) to coordinate availability and route this to one of our runtime engineers for the deep-dive.

Action items:
- Vivek will propose 3 slots this week and confirm attendee list on your side (Alex OK?).
- We'll include one runtime engineer who can speak to KV cache and kernel selection.

Proposed high-level agenda (we'll finalize once slot confirmed):
1) 10m intro: your objectives + quickstart notes
2) 25m technical: latency profile, batching patterns, deployment options
3) 10m next steps: POC sizing and trial plan

Vivek — can you send Julie a short poll with PST-friendly options?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise SDR Lead | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Julie Park <julie@buildloop.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickstart — scheduling a technical demo with runtime engineer

Hi Julie — Vivek here from Redwood. Quick availability to pick a slot: all times are PST. Please reply with the number that works best.

1) Thu 18 Apr, 3:00–3:45pm
2) Fri 19 Apr, 11:00–11:45am
3) Mon 22 Apr, 1:00–1:45pm

We’ll send a calendar invite to the confirmed attendees and include a join link + short prep doc.

Also: do you want us to include a brief run of your quickstart artifacts against a demo model so we can show metric comparisons? If yes, please share an API key or sample payload (redacted) ahead of the call.

— Vivek
Technical SDR | Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Julie Park <julie@buildloop.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickstart — scheduling a technical demo with runtime engineer

Hi Julie — Priyom here, runtime eng. I can take the technical portion. Thanks for the checklist — a couple quick pre-demo asks to make the session high-signal: 
- Can you paste a single representative request payload (inputs + preferred max tokens) or a sanitized transcript?
- Do you have an actual QPS/throughput curve, or should I assume bursty traffic around 2k/min?

If you prefer not to share payloads beforehand, no problem — we can use a synthetic profile. Also adding a couple notes on what I'll demo:
- KV-cache behavior with short conversational sessions (latency numbers with and without caching)
- Continuous batching impact on p99 latency under 1–3k req/min
- Quick overview of quantized model variant trade-offs for cost-sensitive workloads

Please confirm which slot from Vivek's list works and whether Alex will join. I'll block the time on my calendar once confirmed.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Runtime Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
